candidates.initial_disturbance: paper-aligned three-phase fault at a traceable network bus
candidates.first_required_observability: PCC voltage plus source V/P/Q and actual DFIG breaker state
candidates.first_protection_candidate: existing DFIG LVRT/local trip path after paper-criterion gap is documented
candidates.network_propagation_link: source power loss and branch P/Q/I/loading redistribution
candidates.second_protection_candidate: future line-overload shadow relay; no breaker connection
candidates.minimum_model_change: First add monitor-only target-line P/Q/I/loading outputs; do not add relay or actuation in that stage.
candidates.future_run_count_before_claim: minimum 2 after staged implementation: one observability baseline and one later shadow-relay evaluation; more required before any natural-cascade claim
candidates.claim_boundary: Paper-aligned candidate design only; no propagation or protection behavior has been implemented or validated.
candidates.rejection_reason_if_not_feasible: Reject if the target branch and its electrical measurements cannot be unambiguously mapped.

candidates.initial_disturbance: short fault followed by recovery-stage line loading increase
candidates.minimum_model_change: Same first step as MC01: branch observability only.
candidates.future_run_count_before_claim: at least 2 staged runs after implementation
candidates.claim_boundary: Alternative paper mechanism, not selected as the minimum current path.
candidates.rejection_reason_if_not_feasible: Less immediately reusable than MC01 because the current audited first protection is source-side DFIG LVRT.

why_this_stage_matches_the_paper: E003, E010 and E012 place branch-flow redistribution and overload between the first source event and later protection actions.
why_other_stages_are_deferred: A relay lacks an audited input and branch boundary; extra UVRT duplicates an already audited source-side path; another fixed-timing Run cannot create the missing network propagation measurement.
